additional_info.subject: ID0445291-DC/Si-D/HU-[MP/S3 170003426] CCS2 plug Connector Damage CRM:02889000476
additional_info.body:
Hi Norbert,
Please proceed with the replacement of the cable and get this information for QM, please:
CP-to-ground Voltage reading (standby)
Signs of corrosion (external)
Evidence of water ingress
Picture of the Cable label
Outlet Number and position (e.g. DC1 - Left)
Cable lifetime from commissioning until replacement
Is it the original cable or has a cable replacement already taken place?
Date of CMS installation (if applicable)
Dates of last OK and first NOK session
EV Manufacturers of last OK and first NOK session (or MAC) - if available
Maximum charging current value (
EVSE_NowCur[A]
) of last 2 weeks before NOK session
How many Charging phases P01-P05 encountered on NOK session (Abortion on P06)
Sum of Energy transfer for the affected outlet in last 12 Months
Count of charging sessions for the affected outlet in the last 12 Months
Do I send this ticket to your queue or shall I close it since a solution has been given?
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
